verdict.rationale: The site publishes some availability windows up front: the online income-return correction service is announced as open from 29 July to 30 November 2026, and a fiscal calendar is linked. These are seasonal service periods only. Nothing shows daily operating hours, per-day submission limits or session-timeout durations being disclosed before a user starts the professional online flow. Missing for 10: daily operating-hours/maintenance windows, per-day limits, session timeout disclosure, professional-space-specific availability info, independent corroboration.
